net/dns#

Names to addresses and back.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let resolver is Resolving = SystemResolution();
let endpoints = await resolver.addresses(HostEndpoint(HostName("example.org"), 443));
let name = await resolver.name(IpAddress("93.184.215.14"));

let fixed = FixedResolution(hosts: [HostAddresses(HostName("db"), [IpAddress("10.0.0.5")])]);

Description#

Names to addresses and back.

Code takes a Resolving so tests can give a FixedResolution. SystemResolution asks the operating system's resolver.

object HostAddresses

Explicit configuration records, never native DNS wire records or object map keys. Snapshot at construction; canonical identity and source order are exact.
